units.locator: Article 14.56.1. Unlawful solicitation of investments from individuals
units.text: 1. Providing services to solicit investments from individuals by a person not entitled to conduct that activity under legislation on protection of investors’ rights and legitimate interests in the securities market and restrictions on soliciting investments from individuals, except in the cases provided for by Article 14.62 of this Code, where those acts do not contain the elements of a criminal offence, —
units.label: Part 1 Art. 14.56.1

units.locator: Article 14.56.1. Unlawful solicitation of investments from individuals
units.text: shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of five thousand to thirty thousand roubles; for officials, twenty thousand to fifty thousand roubles; for persons engaging in entrepreneurial activity without forming a legal entity, twenty thousand to fifty thousand roubles, or administrative suspension of activity for up to sixty days; for legal entities, three hundred thousand to five hundred thousand roubles, or administrative suspension of activity for up to sixty days.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 14.56.1 · “shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of five…”

units.locator: Article 14.56.1. Unlawful solicitation of investments from individuals
units.text: 2. Soliciting investments from individuals in violation of the requirements of Clause 1 of Article 5.1 of Federal Law of 5 March 1999 No. 46-FZ “On Protection of the Rights and Legitimate Interests of Investors in the Securities Market”, except in the cases provided for by Article 14.62 of this Code, where those acts do not contain the elements of a criminal offence, —
units.label: Part 2 Art. 14.56.1

units.locator: Article 14.56.1. Unlawful solicitation of investments from individuals
units.text: shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of thirty thousand to fifty thousand roubles; for officials, fifty thousand to one hundred thousand roubles; for persons engaging in entrepreneurial activity without forming a legal entity, fifty thousand to one hundred thousand roubles, or administrative suspension of activity for up to ninety days; for legal entities, five hundred thousand to one million roubles, or administrative suspension of activity for up to ninety days.

units.text: 1. Organisation or conduct by a person of activities to raise funds and/or other property from individuals and/or legal entities whereby income is paid and/or another benefit is provided to persons whose funds and/or other property were raised earlier using funds and/or other property raised from other individuals and/or legal entities, in the absence of investment and/or other lawful entrepreneurial or other activity using the funds and/or other property raised on a scale comparable to the amount of funds and/or other property raised, where those acts do not constitute a criminal offence, —
